s05133.summary: Dev drives two strangers through the night, making stiff small talk.
Nadia takes a furious call from Luke; the passenger's hood comes down.
Marcus unzips the bag of cash and Dev brakes hard, realizing it is no ride.

s05134.summary: Maya and Jalen, last members of a group chat, meet awkwardly at the skate park.
A stranger's message warns them off going home and the streetlight dies.
They crouch in the dark, trusting each other as footsteps approach.

s05135.summary: The school nurse gently coaxes pale Tess, who insists she only skipped breakfast.
Kira spots tape on Tess's arm and argues with Bea about telling.
The nurse asks for Tess's mother; Margaret appears and Tess apologizes.

s05136.summary: Producer David tells Kim her take sounds like ordering coffee.
Kim, Kip and two Davids trade quips about who wrote what.
Kip asks if Kim is leaving the song or the band; she says roll tape.

s05138.summary: Minicab driver Barry makes chatty small talk with a silent woman and her violin case.
At the auction house the Quartet greets her, and Barry notes she knows his name.
She shows the empty case, tells Barry to wait, and leaves; he kills the engine.

s05139.summary: During a 1974 blackout a family sits tensely in a candlelit kitchen.
Frank phones to say the hospital called; Eleanor stalls and the family reacts.
Gerald folds the catalogue and asks Eleanor to put the kettle on.

s05140.summary: Documentarian Priya interviews an old man at his storage unit.
Her producer calls with a warning about the name before the call drops.
Walt opens the unit full of crates and admits he lied about his unit.
The crates hold four hundred and six names as the lights go out.

s05141.summary: Public defender Marisol confides her shaking hands to Quinn while getting a manicure.
A watching woman reveals she is the mother of the man Marisol will cross-examine.
The argument escalates and Dolores throws a cup, shattering the polish bottles.

s05142.summary: Online friends meet at a library, joking nervously about height.
A message from no one arrives and the Orbit speaks from all three phones.
Okoye admits she always knew as the lights dim and phones read Home.

s05143.summary: Tessa livestreams a dance with nervous Cam, who guards a tote bag.
A woman in a raincoat watches them and starts walking over as chat panics.
A flash mob covers their escape and they run, laughing and terrified.
Detective Mara waits at the gate and asks what is in the bag.

s05146.summary: Two women on a 1953 night bus watch each other in tense silence.
Black coat reaches into her bag, finding only a handkerchief.
Green produces a letter bearing Black's name and withholds it.
Green says she wrote the letter; Eleanor sees a face like her own.

s05147.summary: Former detective Jess wipes benches in the early gym, narrating her past.
A hooded man shows a photo of his missing sister and asks Jess for help.
He gives his name, Kyle Brandt, a name Jess buried.
Big Mo appears with a bloody towel; Kyle says he last saw her.
Jess steps between them and orders Mo to open the back room.

s05149.summary: A man waits alone in a parole office where the clock is stuck.
A woman arrives, expecting him, and mixes up Kip and Kim.
She shows his file with red handwriting he did not write; footsteps approach.
Margaret introduces the presence behind him as Kip, who is dead.

s05151.summary: A woman greets an empty AA meeting and jokes about her sobriety.
Her purse wiggles, and she reveals her ex-husbands were turned into frogs.
A staff taps down the stairs and stops behind Brenda, a four-hundred-year-old witch.

s05152.summary: Imani hides during a lockdown and takes a whispered call from Jonah.
She sprints forty feet to kill the east lights, driving the creature away.
The dog barks, the scraping reverses, and bloodied Jonah says it was never in the vents.

s05154.summary: At a climate protest Jen and ex Sam bicker as the polar bear crashes into a bin.
A barefoot stranger announces he is from two hundred years in the future.
Pip pops out of the bear; everyone laughs and Mrs. K urges Oz to march.

s05155.summary: Anika, trembling over her coffee, rides a nearly empty night bus.
Riley guesses Anika is a nurse and talks about their mother.
Riley urges her to return the hospital's seven missed calls; she snaps.
Anika admits she left for twelve minutes and a boy nearly died.
Riley exits, having used a name never given; Anika calls the ward.

s05156.summary: Two rival bridesmaids in the same mint dress meet on a night bus.
They trade gossip about the angry bride and the ruined cake.
Delivery man Winston shares pineapple pizza; both women say the bride threatened them.
The bus stops at a silent bright future and Lucia offers to explore.

s05157.summary: Nadia hides in a bathroom stall during a siege, texting her mom.
Kofi and injured Lucas burst in and discover Nadia hiding.
Ms. Brandt pleads to be let in; the kids doubt her as juniors creep past.
Kofi's hand stays on the mop as a bang shakes the door.

s05158.summary: Solicitor Okonkwo presses officer Grieve to pass her client's suspicious papers.
The Home Office says the order was revoked and the two are not who they claim.
The sleeping girl wakes and calls Okonkwo Mummy; Grieve drops the clipboard.

s05159_0.summary: Nervous Beth and Cal wait at a fertility clinic, joking until called in.

s05159_1.summary: Beth and Cal admit to Dr. Okafor they are terrified after three years.
A lab call interrupts; Okafor hangs up and tells them to breathe.
It is a yes; Beth cries and Cal celebrates and they embrace.

s05160.summary: On take nineteen, engineer Osei and singer Juniper argue over the rushed bridge.
Marguerite calls about the label deadline and Juniper hurls their headphones.

s05161.summary: Supervisor Barry cheerfully greets a tired, unimpressed warehouse crew.
An unscanned box marked private rolls by and Barry panics.
Nadine opens the box: shampoos, stolen name tags, and a self-made award.
The warehouse applauds; Robin crowns the mortified Barry with the sign.
